# Nylas

> > Nylas provides unified APIs for email, calendar, and contacts integration, enabling developers to build communication features into applications with support for Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and other providers.

Nylas offers Email API, Calendar API, Contacts API, and Nylas Scheduler as core products, alongside AI-powered features like ExtractAI. The platform serves enterprise customers across sales, HR, recruiting, and productivity use cases with OAuth authentication, Microsoft 365 admin approval workflows, and comprehensive developer tools.

## Key Topics

- Nylas Email API
- Nylas Calendar API
- Nylas Contacts API
- Nylas Scheduler
- ExtractAI
- Microsoft 365 integration
- OAuth authentication
- Admin approval workflows
- Email deliverability
- Webhooks and automation
- Sales productivity
- HR and recruiting solutions
- Developer tutorials
- API v3
- Enterprise security
